Then in `reflex/components/component.py`, `Component.create` normalizes non-Component children into `Bare.create(...)`, so every string literal above becomes its own component node. The recursion itself is in `Component.render` (just below the `_render` method region I read): it calls `tag = self._render()`, then sets `children=[child.render() for child in self.children]`. So each component node in the tree contributes exactly one call to `Component.render`, starting from `dashboard.render()`.
